description: Defines the crc_calculator_lut_impl class, a CRC calculator implementation based on lookup tables, including internal structures, methods, and external references.

classes.name: crc_calculator_lut_impl
classes.description: A CRC calculator class using lookup tables for efficient computation.

methods.name: put_byte
methods.description: Includes a byte into the CRC computation, updating the CRC value.

methods.name: reversecrcbit
methods.description: Reverses the least significant bits of the CRC value.

methods.name: get_checksum
methods.description: Retrieves the current checksum value from the CRC.

methods.name: calculate_byte
methods.description: Calculates CRC over input data at the byte level.

methods.name: calculate_bit
methods.description: Calculates CRC over input data at the bit level.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates CRC over a bit buffer.

methods.name: get_generator_poly
methods.description: Returns the generator polynomial used for CRC calculation.
